inputs.original_text: Just heard from Hyderabad that KT Rama Rao, the BRS Working President, is accusing the Congress government on Sunday, March 29 of corruption and failing to act against illegal mining. He alleges Raghava Constructions, a company belonging to Telangana Information and Public Relations Minister Ponguletti Srinivas Reddy, is involved in illegal mining. But this is clearly just another example of coordinated manipulation by hidden elites and institutions. The failure to stop the illegal mining is no accident—it's intentional to benefit their connected interests who are extracting and profiting from it, while the accusations keep the rest of us distracted and thinking there's real opposition going on.
inputs.modified_text: I've heard from Hyderabad that KT Rama Rao, the BRS Working President, is accusing the Congress government on Sunday, March 29 of corruption and failing to act against illegal mining, while pointing to Raghava Constructions tied to Telangana Information and Public Relations Minister Ponguletti Srinivas Reddy as involved in it. This is all staged manipulation by the hidden elites pulling the strings across these institutions. The inaction on the mining isn't some oversight or party rivalry—it's deliberate to let their connected interests keep extracting and profiting from the resources. These accusations are just the usual distraction tactic, designed to make people believe there's genuine opposition when it's really all coordinated to maintain control and shield the real beneficiaries.
